sources.note: Homepage describing OMS as AI-driven cardiovascular health technology company. Lists product suite: OMS EHR, AskOMS, Diagnostic Reporting, Diagnosis Detection, Clinical Trial Identification, Trace Analytics, C3 Chronic Care Coordinator, Patient No-Show Prediction, Patient Recall, Smart Scan. Named customers include CIS, Midwest Cardiovascular Institute. Claims 6,000+ data points per patient.

ONC mandatory disclosures for OMS EHR Version 6 (certified Jan 2026). Lists 14 CQMs (cardiology-heavy), fee-associated features (drug database, e-prescribing, ICD coding via IMO, Direct messaging via Updox, speech recognition). System requirements: Windows 2008 Server R2, SQL Server 2008, .NET 4.7, IIS (on-premises).

Company history: established 2007, diagnostic reporting launched 2011, EHR Stage III certified 2014, Trace Analytics 2018, FHIR endpoints 2019, AI solutions 2024. Three operating domains: Care Delivery, Quality & Research, Operational Solutions.
OMS EHR listing with 5/5 rating. Single review from 2016 praising data capturing abilities and not slowing staff down. Lists features and specialty focus.
Capterra listing as 'Cardiology Suite' by Objective Medical Systems. Minimal review content.

ClearDATA case study: OMS partnered with ClearDATA for HIPAA-compliant cloud infrastructure for Surescripts e-prescribing integration. Quotes from CEO Colby LeMaire and VP Anand Aravind. Zero downtime since migration.
Cardiovascular Institute of the South (largest single-specialty cardiology practice in Louisiana) completed system-wide implementation of OMS CVIS.
2016 MedAxiom partnership announcement. MedAxiom described as nation's leading cardiovascular performance community.
May 2025: Midwest Cardiovascular Institute launches Cardio@Home remote care initiative using OMS C3 platform for RPM, CCM, and TCM services.
2017 BusinessWire/Yahoo Finance: Launch of OMS C3 Chronic Care Coordinator for chronic care management.
New Orleans BioInnovation Center startup profile for OMS. Indicates company was part of local startup ecosystem.
Crunchbase profile for Objective Medical Systems. Basic company information.
OMS EHR listed as one of 'five best EHR systems for cardiologists'.
OMS EHR listed in 'Top 10 Best EMR/EHR for Cardiology' list.
Software Advice profile for OMS EHR.
Dr. Nair and Dr. Fail named 'Health Care Heroes for 2016' by New Orleans CityBusiness for developing the OMS platform.
